chose: A source's quote holds at least 8 characters (QUOTE_LEAST), matched as a substring of the cited lines or file, whitespace aside. A shorter quote is refused when the essay is read.
options: at least one whole word, matched on word boundaries
gray: How short a quote may be decides how much a passing source proves; a one-letter quote is found in every file, and too long a minimum makes a citation fragile. No check or earlier decision sets it.
undo: Change QUOTE_LEAST in packages/video-render/src/claims.ts; no essay with sources is published yet.
